# Heteroscedasticity Test Factory

<small>Source: [`R/test_factory.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/test_factory.R) · Help: `?TestFactory`</small>

Provides a registry of heteroscedasticity tests with metadata and
convenience methods to run them with input validation. This is an
alternative to the older environment-based registry used by
`runHeteroTests()`.

## Deprecated

`TestFactory` and its shared instance `test_factory` are deprecated since
0.14.0: they are the package's internal machinery and leave the exports in
1.0.0. They are objects rather than functions, so they cannot warn when
used; this page and `NEWS.md` are the notice. Use [`registerDiagnostic()`](registerDiagnostic.md) to
add a test and [`runHeteroTests()`](runHeteroTests.md) to run one.

## Usage

The shared instance `test_factory` can be used to register new tests
and execute them. See `register` and `run_test` methods
for details.

## Methods

### Public methods

- `TestFactory$register()`
- `TestFactory$get_available()`
- `TestFactory$run_test()`
- `TestFactory$clone()`

### Method `register()`

#### Usage

```r
TestFactory$register(name, func, metadata = list())
```

#### Arguments

`name`
:   Name of the test

`func`
:   Function with arguments `model` and `data`

`metadata`
:   Optional list with metadata fields

#### Returns

Invisibly returns the factory
Get available tests

### Method `get_available()`

#### Usage

```r
TestFactory$get_available(data_type = NULL, min_n = NULL)
```

#### Arguments

`data_type`
:   Filter by supported data type

`min_n`
:   Filter by minimum observations

#### Returns

Character vector of test names
Run a registered test

### Method `run_test()`

#### Usage

```r
TestFactory$run_test(test_name, model, data, ...)
```

#### Arguments

`test_name`
:   Name of the test

`model`
:   Fitted model

`data`
:   Data frame used to fit the model

`...`
:   Additional arguments passed to the test

#### Returns

Result of the test
